outcome: diversity and composition of breast milk (BM) microbiota
diversity and composition of gut microbiota (GM)
cohort: The study included 40 mother-newborn dyads exclusively breastfeeding at 20-28 days postpartum.
finding: Excessive maternal adiposity, maternal age, and C-section delivery were found to influence a lower abundance of specific taxa in the breast milk, maternal gut, and newborn gut microbiota, with maternal age and newborn sex also explaining important variation in microbiota composition.
mod_finding: C-section delivery was associated with a lower abundance of specific taxa in the breast milk, maternal gut, and newborn gut microbiota.
